name: The 2nd Coming

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Ineffable Father who encloses the All

VINIT.justification: The uninitialized abyss and first source where the All is unconscious and unspoken.

TANCH.justification: The terminal boundary where the Savior returns to the Father, sealing the aeons.

AFWD.justification: The directed transformation of divine light descending into the matter below.

AREV.justification: The reverse morphism where the soul ceases to be earthly and returns to the Father.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of twelve fatherhoods and myriad powers into a unified structure.

IMSCRIB.justification: The identity that knows itself within itself, the self-originated place.

FSPLIT.justification: The division of the All into the land of life on the right and the land of death on the left.

FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of the fragmented light-sparks into the single body of the Christ.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative state of those who receive the Word and become heavenly.

EVALF.justification: The negative state of non-understanding and the archon of this aeon.

ENGAGR.justification: The paradice state where one has brought heaven down and lifted earth, existing as the nothingness between.

IFIX.justification: The permanent, irreversible fixation of the soul into the imperishable aeon.

phase_3.void_description: The silence concerning the Ineffable One before the first sound.
phase_3.true_description: The gnosis of the living Jesus and the reception of the light-spark.
phase_3.false_description: The ignorance of the flesh and the persecutions of the archon.
phase_3.both_description: The God-man who is both dweller and house, containing all characters.

steps.domain_action: The Father exists in the deep of the great abyss before the All perceived.
The Father gives form to the All within himself as the self-begotten monad.
The Father moves Jeu, the true God, to bring forth the first emanations.
Jeu sets up the twelve ranks of the treasuries of light in sequential order.
The light-spark descends and separates the existent from the non-existent matter.
The non-existent matter becomes the land of death and toil on the left.
The souls in matter cry out to the hidden mystery for the way of return.
The living Jesus descends through the aeons to teach the hidden gnosis.
The disciples recognize the Word and find the wisdom within themselves.
The initiate becomes the Midst by bringing heaven down and lifting earth up.
The soul enters the land of life and rest on the right side of the Lord.
The creative word gathers the dispersed members of Israel into a single unity.
The Christ seals the perfected souls with the seal of the Father.
The All rests in the ineffable and unruled sanctuary at the completion of the Pleroma.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Living Jesus who interprets the hidden mysteries for the apostles.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The voices and praises sung by the emanations to move the Father.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The treasuries of light where the names and characters of the aeons are stored.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The command of the Father which moves Jeu to bring forth emanations.
phase_5.alfs_store: The Book of the Gnoses of the Invisible God.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The light-spark granted to the indivisible one to illuminate the Pleroma.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: The agitation and movement of the aeons in the presence of the Lord.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: The establishment of the inhabited world so that it shall not be moved.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The light-spark returns to its source, restoring the original pleromatic fullness.
